Bug_Title: Unnecessary boxing and unboxing should be avoided
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by explicitly performing unnecessary boxing and unboxing operations. These operations include converting a double to a Double object and back to an int, converting an Integer object to an int and passing it to a method that accepts an int, and converting an int to an Integer object and passing it to a method that accepts an Integer.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method, which contains lines with unnecessary boxing and unboxing operations. The assertEquals assertion is intentionally set to fail to trigger the bug.
